en.t: Do not you dare say it is impossible!

units.source_text: 男人忽然愤愤不平起来。
死缠在记忆里的不祥之兆，终于使他把本来说不出口的“绳梯”搬了出来，

en.t: The ominous sign that clung stubbornly to his memory finally made him bring up the rope ladder he had not been able to mention,

units.source_text: “那天，我逃跑的半路上，清清楚楚地看见过的哟……

en.t: That day, halfway through my escape, I saw it perfectly clearly...

units.source_text: 这边并排的房子里，有好几家都随意地吊着绳梯呢。”

en.t: Several of the houses lined up over here had rope ladders hanging down as if it were nothing.
